claims.claim: A prediction-sufficient state may miss a secondary task/responsibility target.
Epistemic state requirements are defined by explicit decision semantics, not by arbitrary auxiliary target recovery.
For ANY_OPTIMAL_ACTION, exact static extra state cost beyond S_P is min over Bayes-optimal selectors d of H(d(H)|S_P).
Canonical action cost is H(d_tau(H)|S_P); full optimal-set and action+risk semantics use their registered signature entropies; exact target gives H(Q|S_P).
For multiple ANY_OPTIMAL_ACTION responsibilities, jointly optimize Bayes-optimal selectors to minimize joint conditional action entropy.
Entropy-minimal deterministic exact predictive state is isomorphic to S_P on support.
Maximal exact predictive compression is safe for a responsibility iff a Bayes-optimal responsibility policy can be implemented from S_P.
Static ANY_OPTIMAL_ACTION state is minimum-entropy predictive-refining action-compatible partition; dynamic state adds right-congruence constraint.
Joint exact dynamic policy/state optimum equals minimum over Bayes-optimal selectors of the entropy of the coarsest right-congruent refinement of (S_P,d).
Dynamic epistemic optionality premium Omega_dyn = C_dyn^* - C_stat^* >= 0 measures irreducible recurrent-state cost beyond the optimal static responsibility state.
Canonical equal-prior provenance case has C_stat^*=0, C_dyn^*=1 bit, Omega_dyn=1 bit even after joint Bayes-optimal policy optimization.
Prospective deficit I(Q_future;H_now|Z_now,X_future) identifies past information discarded now that later evidence cannot reconstruct.
Responsibility-family cost is bounded by H(H|S_P); fibre-separating families saturate this bound; unrestricted exact responsibilities force history-recoverable state.
Predictive loss and static hidden-state probes cannot certify minimum prospective responsibility-state adequacy; controlled future-evidence revision is a distinct representation test.
